title: A Silent Scheme
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone thought the matter was settled, an aged voice rang out from above the clouds: "The Tianqing Sect has not accepted disciples for three hundred years. Today, I shall make an exception and take a servant disciple into my sect."

text.content: The night was as dark as ink. A sliver of moonlight filtered through the small window of the Servants' Quarters. Chen Ji sat cross-legged on a worn meditation cushion, eyes lowered, resembling a clay sculpture in meditation. Only his fingertips gently rubbed against his chest, where the Tianji Record Fragment was hidden—his true trump card. "The Sect Competition in three days..." His lips curved slightly, a half-smile forming. "Zhang Shen, do you think I don't know what you wrote on that Jade Slip?"

dialogue.content: On the fragment, the lingering soul shadow of Mo Xiansheng slowly emerged, his voice hoarse like ancient wind: "Zhang Shen has allied with Han Lie of the Xuanwu Sect. Under the charge of 'treason and collusion with the enemy,' they plan to make their move during the finals. If you lose, they'll cripple your cultivation. If you win, they'll claim you fled in fear of your crimes." He paused. "At that point, you'll have no way to defend yourself."

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing. He closed his eyes, and the Tianji Record in his chest grew warm—that was the premonition of seeing the future. Images surged like a tide: on the arena platform of the Sect Competition, Zhang Shen arrogantly reading out his "charges," surrounding disciples either angry or indifferent, not a single soul speaking for him. And he, held by two disciples of the Law Enforcement Hall, unable to move. "Interesting." He opened his eyes, cold light flickering in his gaze. "Zhang Shen, you invited Han Lie to压阵, then let me show you what it means to have a flawless strategy."

dialogue.content: He stood up, walked to the window, gazing toward the brightly lit Main Peak in the distance. His voice was soft, as if speaking to himself: "Mo Xiansheng, please help me investigate something—who currently holds that batch of 'Xuanbing Cold Iron' lost from the Xuanwu Sect three years ago?"

Mo Xiansheng's shadow hesitated slightly, a flash of appreciation crossing his eyes: "You suspect that batch of cold iron was privately taken by Zhang Shen to bribe Han Lie?" Chen Ji shook his head: "Not suspect—certain. Zhang Shen has ambitions higher than the heavens, yet his cultivation resources are lacking in every aspect. Besides this, I can't think of what leverage he could have to recruit the number one prodigy of the Xuanwu Sect." He turned around, moonlight casting interlacing light and shadow across his face. "Mo Xiansheng, help me leak this information to Ye Qing."

"The Demon Path Holy Sect's Saint?" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a playful tone. "Are you sure she'll help you?" Chen Ji smiled faintly: "She's not helping me—she's helping herself. That batch of cold iron Zhang Shen privately took was originally contraband that flowed out from the Demon Path's hands. If Ye Qing can use this to retrieve the cold iron and顺便give the Xuanwu Sect a hard time, why not?" His smile held three parts of cold detachment. "And I, only need a witness."

text.content: Three days passed in a flash. On the day of the Sect Competition, the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena was crowded with people, banners fluttering in the wind. Above the platform, Sect Master Ling Yuan sat in the main seat, expressionately aloof; on both sides were the peak leaders and outer sect elders who came to observe. Around the arena, disciples stood in order of seniority, murmuring about today's final matchups. Chen Ji stood in the ranks of Servant Disciples, dressed in gray cloth garments, unremarkable as a fallen leaf on a blue stone slab.

dialogue.content: He slightly raised his eyes, just in time to meet Zhang Shen's gaze. That gaze carried undisguised contempt and triumph, like a cat watching a mouse about to be toyed with. Chen Ji calmly looked away, but in his heart, he coldly sneered: "Enjoy it while you can. There'll be a time for you to cry." He unconsciously touched the fragment at his chest, where the Tianji Record's aura was sealed under a layer of suppression, not leaking even a trace.

text.content: The finals began. As an Inner Disciple seed player, Zhang Shen naturally took the stage first. Clad in splendid robes, wielding a spiritual sword, full of vigor and enthusiasm, he earned thunderous applause. In contrast, when Chen Ji took the stage, there were only scattered remarks, mostly disdain: "Him? That废物servant?" "I heard he hasn't even broken through to Qi Gathering stage. How does he deserve to stand on the finals arena?" "This is an insult to the path of cultivation!" Hearing these remarks, Zhang Shen's smile grew even wider.

choice.prompt: The finals begin. Zhang Shen prepares his attack. How will you counter his first wave of assault?

choices.text: Feign weakness to lure the enemy, letting him become complacent first
choices.description: Deliberately appear disheveled in combat, causing Zhang Shen to lower his guard and buying space for a counterattack.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 5 Heavenly Fate points to foresee, precisely timing the counterattack
choices.visible_reward: Gain Zhang Shen's contempt, weakening his wariness
choices.risk_hint: If the acting isn't convincing enough, Su Qingyao might see through it

text.content: Combat began. Zhang Shen thrust his sword, momentum as swift as a torrential river. Chen Ji "frantically" dodged, but was grazed by the sword wind, stumbling back several steps,狼狈地kneeling on one knee. "Waste of space, can't even block one move!" Zhang Shen burst into laughter, his attacks growing increasingly fierce. Chen Ji "barely" parried, his whole body gaining over a dozen wounds, blood dyeing his gray cloth garments red. The crowd below erupted in boos.

choices.text: Fight steadily,试探his trump cards with minimal consumption
choices.description: Don't expose too much strength, but don't overdo the weakness either. Observe whether Zhang Shen has other hidden手段.
choices.visible_cost: Need to consume spiritual energy to应对Zhang Shen's attacks
choices.visible_reward: Gain more intelligence, providing information for subsequent scheming
choices.risk_hint: May give Zhang Shen the chance to strike early

text.content: Chen Ji responded to Zhang Shen's fierce attacks with basic sword techniques. On the surface, he seemed to be in grave danger, but in reality, he was handling it with ease. He caught Zhang Shen's openings in the sword wind while secretly observing his surroundings—the disciples of the Law Enforcement Hall had already quietly moved toward the arena's edge, clearly waiting for Zhang Shen's signal to make their move.

As expected, when the combat reached the thirtieth move, Zhang Shen suddenly sheathed his sword and stepped back, shouting loudly: "Hold! Chen Ji, you colluded with the Demon Path and sold sect secrets—evidence is conclusive!" He took a Jade Slip from his sleeve and unfolded it before everyone: "This is correspondence between you and the Demon Path. The handwriting has been authenticated. Today, I shall cleanse the sect for you!" At these words, the entire crowd gasped. The Law Enforcement Hall disciples immediately surrounded Chen Ji, blocking all retreat paths.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood in place, his expression terrifyingly calm. He looked around at those righteous fellow disciples, at the Sect Master Ling Yuan who sat high above in silence, and finally fixed his gaze on Zhang Shen's triumphant face. "Evidence conclusive?" His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. "Then I wonder, Brother Zhang, where did this 'evidence' come from?"

Zhang Shen coldly laughed: "You still want to deny it? The handwriting on this Jade Slip, authenticated by three elders, is identical to your usual copying of scriptures!" Chen Ji gently shook his head, the corner of his mouth instead curling into a smile: "Handwriting can be imitated. Surely Brother Zhang knows this." He paused, then shifted topics. "There is something I'm quite curious about—have you heard of the batch of Xuanbing Cold Iron lost by the Xuanwu Sect three years ago, Brother Zhang?"

text.content: Zhang Shen's expression changed instantly. That change lasted only a moment, but Chen Ji caught it all. "Xuanbing Cold Iron?" He feigned confusion. "What does this have to do with today's matter?" Chen Ji didn't answer. Instead, he turned toward the high platform and said loudly: "This disciple requests a public search—not of my soul, but of my possessions! Please, Brother Zhang, prove your innocence—let's see if there's something in your sleeves that doesn't belong to you!" At these words, the entire crowd gasped once more.

choice.prompt: At this critical moment, how will you force Zhang Shen to show his hand?

choices.text: Directly point out the cold iron, causing Zhang Shen to reveal flaws in public
choices.description: Directly expose Zhang Shen's private theft of cold iron to bribe Han Lie, disrupting his rhythm.
choices.visible_cost: May expose trump cards too early
choices.visible_reward: Zhang Shen will be humiliated in public, reputation ruined
choices.risk_hint: If there's no substantial evidence, may be accused of slander instead

text.content: Chen Ji spoke word by word: "Three years ago, the Xuanwu Sect lost three hundred jin of Xuanbing Cold Iron. The handler was the outer sect steward Li Ping. And Li Ping died suddenly half a year ago—the last person he saw before his death was precisely you, Brother Zhang." He slightly narrowed his eyes. "Brother Zhang, that piece of cold iron hidden in your sleeve—would you like to take it out and show everyone?"

choices.text: Hold back without striking, waiting for Ye Qing's people to appear as witnesses
choices.description: Maintain an air of mystery, letting the Demon Path Saint's "witness" appear at the right moment, forming a double strike.
choices.visible_cost: Need Ye Qing's people to appear on time
choices.visible_reward: With both human and material evidence present, Zhang Shen has no way to deny
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing's people are late, timing will completely spiral out of control

text.content: Just as Zhang Shen was stunned, a commotion arose at the entrance of the Martial Arena. A black-robed woman walked in gracefully, demonic energy swirling around her—that was the Demon Path Holy Sect's Saint, Ye Qing. Behind her followed two attendants, carrying a jade casket in their hands. "Chen Ji, the three-day agreement, I'm here." Ye Qing's voice was cold as frost. "I also bring evidence of Zhang Shen's private theft of my Holy Sect's cold iron."

Ye Qing opened the jade casket. Inside was赫然a fist-sized piece of Xuanbing Cold Iron, its cold air biting. She then took out a Jade Slip. With a flash of light, an image was projected—it was the complete secret transaction between Zhang Shen and a black-clad figure three years ago! "This recording, my Holy Sect has preserved for three years." Ye Qing looked around, a playful smile on her lips. "Today, I offer it as a gift to the Tianqing Sect."

dialogue.content: Zhang Shen's face turned ashen, cold sweat dripping from his forehead. He never expected that Chen Ji, this废物servant, could actually recruit the Demon Path Saint to act! "You... you colluded with the Demon Path!" He pointed at Chen Ji, voice trembling. "Evidence is conclusive!" Chen Ji smiled gently. That smile was like spring breeze brushing across everyone's faces, yet the words that followed were incisive: "Brother Zhang, just now you falsely accused me of colluding with the Demon Path. Now the Demon Path Saint personally testifies that you privately took contraband—then who, I ask, is colluding with the Demon Path?"

text.content: Complete silence fell over the crowd. Above the platform, Sect Master Ling Yuan's brow furrowed almost imperceptibly, then returned to calm. The peak leaders looked at each other in bewilderment. The disciples of the Law Enforcement Hall were caught between advancing and retreating—they were originally Zhang Shen's backup, yet now didn't know how to salvage the situation. And Zhang Shen, like a rooster with its neck strangled, lips quivering, unable to utter a single word for a long while.

dialogue.content: Among the crowd, Su Qingyao's gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a long time. Her intuition told her this废物junior brother was far from being as simple as he appeared. But at this moment, she could only suppress her doubts, step forward, her voice cold: "Zhang Shen, you forged evidence and slandered a fellow disciple. According to sect rules, you shall receive thirty lashes and be confined for three years. Do you have any objections?" Zhang Shen shuddered all over, crashing to his knees: "Sect Master, spare my life! Disciple... disciple was momentarily confused!"

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, concealing the flash of cold light in his gaze. He knew today's matter would never end just like this. Zhang Shen was merely a chess piece; the true opponent was that aloof figure who watched in silence, Sect Master Ling Yuan. But for now, what he needed was not revenge, but to lie in wait. He raised his head, showing appropriate fear: "This disciple... this disciple only wishes to cultivate purely and cleanly, never imagined being dragged into these disputes." His voice trembled slightly, like a frightened fawn. "Thank you, Senior Sister Su, for upholding justice."

dialogue.content: "Well done." Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a hint of relief. "However, Ling Yuan has already noticed you. He remained still today because he wasn't confident—but next time, he won't give you another chance." Chen Ji said nothing, only nodding slightly. In his heart, he silently calculated: "Next time? When I truly stand up, he won't even have a chance to make a move."

text.content: The commotion in the Martial Arena gradually subsided. The Law Enforcement Hall disciples dragged the collapsed Zhang Shen away. The watching disciples whispered among themselves, their gazes toward Chen Ji now holding more scrutiny and curiosity. This servant disciple once deemed废物, today actually turned the tables in public, dragging the Inner Disciple seed player off his pedestal. Word spread, and the entire Tianqing Sect was discussing this matter. And Chen Ji, still with head bowed, quietly returned to the servant disciples' ranks, as if nothing had happened.

However, just as the competition was about to conclude, the sky suddenly darkened. An aged yet majestic voice rang out from above the clouds, shaking the eardrums of everyone present: "The Tianqing Sect has not accepted disciples for three hundred years. Today, I shall make an exception and take a servant disciple into my sect." Everyone looked up in shock. Above the clouds, a blurry figure loomed indistinctly, its aura unfathomable. Chen Ji's heart lurched—this voice, he had heard countless times in the Tianji Record's prophecies, yet never imagined experiencing it in person.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." The voice spoke again, this time carrying undeniable authority. "Step forward." Chen Ji took a deep breath, walking toward the platform. His pace was neither fast nor slow, his expression still deferential, yet the fragment at his chest was trembling violently—was the Tianji Record warning him, or foreshadowing something? He didn't know. But he knew that from this moment, his fate would completely change.

text.content: The moment he stepped onto the platform, his peripheral vision caught Su Qingyao's complex gaze, Ling Yuan's gloomy expression, and in an unremarkable corner of the crowd, a familiar figure—one of Ye Qing's attendants, nodding slightly at him. Chen Ji silently recited in his heart: "Round one, I won. But this is only the beginning." Above the clouds, the voice sounded once more, carrying a meaningful tone: "From today onward, you are my registered disciple. The rules of the Tianqing Sect... it's time for a change."
